cohort: A twin pregnancy diagnosed with SARS-CoV-2 infection during the third trimester of gestation.
finding: The study identified a pattern of differentially expressed cytokines associated with SARS-CoV-2 infection, detected similar cytokine concentrations in both twins suggesting the SARS-CoV-2-induced cytokine storm is not substantially impaired during placental passage, and found no relevant signs of dysbiosis in the vaginal microbiome.
cross-section timing: Infection diagnosed at the third trimester of gestation.
